name: Command Code

Optional ZDR header x-cmd-zdr is not configured. See commandcode.ai/docs/provider.

name: Open Design
description: Open Design Cloud model plane at https://amr-link.open-design.ai/v1. Bearer keys look like sk-amr-…. OpenAI chat and responses stay on openai.endpoints (no openai.base, so images, audio, and embeddings are not derived). Anthropic Messages is POST /v1/messages, so the Anthropic base is the host root. Public client wiring uses chat/completions for most models, Responses for claude-haiku-5.5 and deepseek-v4-pro, and Anthropic Messages for glm-5.3-flash. API usage shares Design Plan credits with the app. Keys: https://open-design.ai/cloud/api-keys.

name: Wangsu AI Gateway
description: New unified Wangsu gateway (https://www.wangsu.com/document/ai/migration-guide). OpenAI base https://api.edgecloudapp.com/v2/llm/openai derives chat, responses, images, audio, and embeddings. Anthropic Messages is the full URL https://api.edgecloudapp.com/v2/llm/anthropic/messages (the path has no /v1). Gemini base includes /v1beta/models and uses Bearer, matching the sk- token from 令牌管理. v1 URLs on aigateway.edgecloudapp.com are scheduled to stop on 2026-12-31.
